title: Vegetarian Tagine Stew
description: A flavorful and hearty vegetarian stew inspired by North African cuisine, made with tender beans and a rich blend of spices.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of butter in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the Lebanese spice blend and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the dried beans and 2 cups of water, bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter and stir until melted.
Simmer the stew for an additional 10 minutes, or until the beans are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
